Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01). It ranks **32nd of 121** countries.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. 1.0 is the global average, so Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size alone would predict.

Other figures, next to the global average:
- **Work, personal and coursework use:** 47% work (43% globally), 47% personal (40% globally) and 6% coursework (16% globally).
- **Augmentation and automation:** 53% of conversations are augmentation, where Claude helps the person do the task (51% globally). 47% are automation, where Claude does the task itself (49% globally).

The source and methodology are at https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index.
